title: Clean Artifact Standard Subset Mechanism
description:
Replace the ad-hoc artifact system with one clean mechanism where artifact -> standard -> subset is literal in code.

1. Hierarchy contracts: every level owns one root component.rs that mounts its children with #[path] and exports one declaration fn — subset() -> SubsetDeclaration, standard() -> StandardDeclaration, artifact() -> ArtifactDeclaration; plugin root is Plugin::builder(id).artifact(...) and PluginBuilder::try_build walks the tree as the ONLY registration channel. Deletes ArtifactDefinition capability rows, ArtifactKindSpec/OsMediaCapability/MediaType/ArtifactIo/AppIo, .editor()/.viewer()/.document_app()/.artifact_kind(), derive_artifact_facets!, subset!, DerivedArtifactSpec family, ArtifactAnalyzer/ArtifactComposer/ArtifactComposition/ComposerEntry, stdio's registry facet.

2. Every subset is a complete standalone implementation: own Snapshot/Diff/Mutations/inferences, own io, own viewer/editor/examples; never `use`s a sibling subset or standard. The ~28 derived subsets (pdf a/x/e/h/ua/vt, step cc1-6, svg basic/tiny, ifc cobie/cv20/sav, ooxml strict/transitional, zip iso21320, json i-json, xml valid, jpg/tiff baseline) become real subsets; conformance to a base is an io deserializer from the base dialect.

3. All IO goes exclusively over the io system with serializers and deserializers — including the native DSL text grammar and pack binary protocol, which move from schema into io/import/deserializers and io/export/serializers. Framework io reduced to Dialect/ArtifactDialect/ArtifactRef/IoPayload + Serializer/Deserializer traits + IoEntry/IoRegistry + io_route (bounded, deterministic) + io_identify; carrier dialects (binary@raw, txt@utf-8) carry raw file bytes/text so exports stop writing pack bytes into .gif/.png files. WIT gets list-io-entries/io-run/io-sniff guest exports and io-routes/io-run/io-identify host imports; viewers/editors/commands never call codecs directly.

4. All code shared between subsets/standards/artifacts lives in modules at the lowest common owner (plugin/artifact/standard-level modules dirs, cross-plugin modules crates); >=2 consumers required; subset-level modules forbidden. Dissolves plugin-level engine/fsm/registry/config/presence/app-surface dirs, artifact-level schema/examples/opc/interaction-spec, io children h264/boxes/part21/brep/ladder/geometry-import, gif migrations.

5. Taxonomy schemaVersion 6 + new policies (owner-mounts-children, subset isolation, module consumer count, io exclusivity, io declaration completeness, subset standalone, declaration tree) added in report mode first and flipped to enforce after the plugin waves; new subset/standard/artifact scaffolders.

Executed by an Opus 5 coordinator dispatching Sonnet 5 workers (framework F0/F1, stdio shards S1-S6, 3 exemplars, ~29 plugin fan-out, serializer, deletion+ratchet) with Haiku 4.5 read-only scouts. Full plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-artifact-system-validated-ladybug.md
